items.information: **BAHASA INDONESIA:** Kalibata Agustusan 2026 merupakan kompetisi speedcubing yang akan diadakan di Plaza Kalibata, Jakarta. items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg2MDQ4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f2b0d908f18e079874aebc1d845f74b2731566c4/cactusini%20cubini%20chico%20chico.png)](https://www.instagram.com/asa_speedcubing/) --- Bienvenidos a "Pacha Cubing: Jujuy 2026". El nombre del torneo rinde homenaje a la Pachamama, la Madre Tierra en la cosmovisión andina. Durante todo el mes de agosto, nuestra región lleva a cabo un rito ancestral para agradecer a la tierra por sus frutos mediante ofrendas tradicionales, como alimentos, bebidas y hojas de coca. **POR FAVOR LEER LA PESTAÑA ["IMPORTANTE"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PachaCubingJujuy2026#75268-importante-important) PARA REALIZAR EL REGISTRO CORRECTAMENTE** --- Welcome to "Pacha Cubing: Jujuy 2026". The tournament's name pays tribute to the Pachamama, the Mother Earth in the Andean worldview. Throughout August, our region holds an ancestral ritual to thank the earth for its harvest through traditional offerings, such as food, beverages, and coca leaves. **PLEASE READ THE ["IMPORTANT"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PachaCubingJujuy2026#75268-importante-important) TAB IN ORDER TO REGISTER SUCCESSFULLY**

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. -------------------- ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk3NzM0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7cc91f261678c6cb3253be36e27fef7f8f3b2c35/UK%20(2).png) **Please note that this competition has ONLY silent events!** Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentBrasilia2026/register) tab. If you have any problem with how to register, take a look at [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, gender, date of birth and nationality. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition, especially the specific articles of the competition events. By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.
